ImageDescription.value: 1979-1982 Mercedes-Benz W123 photographed in Sault Ste. Marie, Ontario, Canada. This particular W123 is a French-market series 2 example as shown by the yellow headlight bulbs, updated front and rear bumpers, and round headlights. I believe it's a 200 or 200D model due to the low trim specification (lack of right side door mirror) but I'm not sure as the original model badging has been removed.
